title: The watchmaker’s desk
alt: A watchmaker uses fine tweezers to place a small gear into an open pocket watch.
description: Precise hands, tool contact and miniature mechanical detail in an intimate macro photograph.
prompt: An exquisite close editorial photograph of an adult watchmaker repairing an open mechanical pocket watch on dark-green felt. One hand holds fine tweezers placing a tiny brass gear into the exposed mechanism; the other hand steadies the watch at its edge. Coherent five-finger anatomy and real tool contact, beautifully detailed balance wheel, jewels and engraved metal. A detached plain case back, small orderly trays of screws and a loupe remain separate on the desk. Soft warm task light and cool window fill, immaculate tactile precision, mature documentary composition, no readable lettering or logos.
